scripts.dev: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec alchemy dev "$@"' sh
scripts.deploy: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec alchemy deploy "$@"' sh
scripts.plan: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec alchemy plan "$@"' sh
scripts.destroy: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec alchemy destroy "$@"' sh
scripts.github: sh -c 'set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; if [ -z "$GITHUB_TOKEN" ] && command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then GITHUB_TOKEN=$(gh auth token); export GITHUB_TOKEN; fi; exec alchemy deploy --config github.stack.ts --profile admin --yes "$@"' sh
